selection: Next original parameter point after P4, all 100 shots, no selection by result.
admission: Check two distinct TGA members and both 36-bit Pic logs per original shot, (Series,DataSetNr,RunNr) identity, monotone round timestamps, original image layout and size, P1/P5 detector rectangles, control configuration, timing and output lists.
rule: Sum over the 36 native P1 3x3 half-open rectangles in P5 raw pixels; strict count > T, no shifts, no background subtraction.
acceptance: Each prespecified threshold must reproduce every original P5 Pic1 and Pic2 bit for complete agreement. Report candidate, all 21 integers and 9-integer P3/P4 focus separately. Preserve discrepancies and log/predicted rosters. No fitting to P5.
selection_rule: Pic1 count of all occupied sites >=16/36, independently for log and predicted mask. Pic2 target comprises zero-based ROI 7-10,13-16,19-22,25-28; report both point filling and fully occupied rounds.
scope: Same-series holdout on Knottnerus 88Sr; cross-apparatus comparison to Senoo 171Yb. Formal Senoo CAL/VAL uses its own measured inputs.
